dev_checks.scope: Measured complete DEV correctness check with fully restored raw model KV; not encoded-resident attention or a TEST compression score.

encode.scope: One-pass diagnostic stage sums. Metadata, hashing, indexing and other Python overhead are additional; GPU event and wall columns overlap and must not be summed together.

immediate_verification_decode.scope: One-pass diagnostic stage sums. Metadata, hashing, indexing and other Python overhead are additional; GPU event and wall columns overlap and must not be summed together.

ledger.scope: Ideal and integer-CDF bit sums apply only to neural target layers. Actual complete container bytes additionally include the independent layer-zero anchor, descriptors, CRC framing and index. Complete decoder state is charged separately.

limitations: Source, package and report consistency checks do not independently reproduce omitted raw KV or neural weights.
The reported TEST selection may contain only the first tile of a common system/chat prefix; it need not represent held-out document body or later context positions.
Full-cache and concurrent shared-state reductions are arithmetic estimates, not full serialized-cache, memory-capacity or concurrent-serving measurements.
KV containers are serialized and reopened in memory by the benchmark; no durable packet files or cross-process replay artifacts are exported in the normal reports package.
Neural inference is device-specific FP32 with prediction hashes; cross-device/software restart determinism is not established.
GPU neural prediction and CPU entropy stages do not constitute a GPU entropy codec, compact attention implementation or serving latency result.

bf16_probe.scope: BF16 allocation and matmul functionality, not proof of native hardware execution or SDPA support

model_identity.placement: Explicit single device; no device_map, automatic offload, or remote code
